name: Grace Window
author: CoolJam
description: Reopen "closed" windows with SUPER + SHIFT + W. It remaps SUPER + W to hide the focused window to workspace 10 with a one-minute reopen grace period. Uninstall with `~/.config/omarchy/plugins/jam.grace-window/uninstall.sh` to restore your original keybindings. Don't use omarchy plugin remove for this, otherwise you need to remove its managed block from your bindings.lua manually.
